**Visual analysis of test image:**
- Soybean plants still mostly green with scattered small brown/tan discrete spots across leaf surfaces
- Some general yellowing/chlorosis on affected leaves
- Spots appear as scattered discrete dots (not confluent patches)
- No obvious fluffy growth, stem lesions, or root symptoms visible
- Lower canopy leaves showing more spotting than upper

**Comparing candidates:**

**Soybean_rust** (reference): Shows scattered small pustule-like spots on leaves with progressive yellowing — the bottom-left panel of the collage matches closely: plants still green with scattered discrete brown spots spreading across leaves.

**Downy_mildew** (reference): Shows more diffuse pale/yellowish patches on upper surfaces and gray sporulation underneath — less consistent with the discrete brownish spots in the test image.

The scattered discrete brownish spots on still-green leaves with mild general yellowing best match early-to-moderate **Soybean_rust**, which produces scattered uredinia (pustules) that appear as small brown dots on leaf surfaces.
